title: ALS Tool Kit - Videos
description:
University of Utah Health offers a multidisciplinary team approach to the treatment of individuals with ALS. Meeting with a multidisciplinary healthcare team is a unique opportunity—allowing a one-stop location that can address the multiple complications that can arise with ALS. Our team is comprised of specialists who will work with you and your family during the progression of this disease and can provide an individualized, holistic, and comprehensive management approach. 

Please refer to these videos as often as you need. You may want to share them with family members to help them understand what is happening, or you may want to refer to them as you hear something in clinic that you want to review again. This Tool Kit can be a companion to what we offer in the clinic.

If you require an alternative format of this video due to a disability, please email whitney.sarabia@hsc.utah.edu. You will receive a response within 7-14 business days.
